solution.summary: In this paper, we start by rethinking how such multi-stride stereotype affects the LiDAR-based 3D object detectors. To remedy this issue, we propose Singlestride Sparse Transformer (SST) to maintain the original resolution from the beginning to the end of the network.
solution.approach: In this paper, we start by rethinking how such multi-stride stereotype affects the LiDAR-based 3D object detectors.

evidence.quote: In this paper, we start by rethinking how such multi-stride stereotype affects the LiDAR-based 3D object detectors.
To remedy this issue, we propose Singlestride Sparse Transformer (SST) to maintain the original resolution from the beginning to the end of the network.
Armed with transformers, our method addresses the problem of insufficient receptive field in single-stride architectures.

experiments.summary: Our experiments point out that the downsampling operations bring few advantages, and lead to inevitable information loss. Eventually, our SST achieves state-of-the-art results on the largescale Waymo Open Dataset.
